shows.titleJP: 僕のヒーローアカデミア

reviews.text: So I go all over on this show; it's super SJ, it's got weird and dumb characters and arcs. But then it's got this charm to it, and just when I think it's terrible and I'm gonna quit, the next season comes back a bit better. Cementos is the real boss hero of this world. I think this show was greatly helped by most of the seasons being 12/24 eps and then Bones would take a break, get enough manga/time/recover and then come back. So, as far as a well done SJ series that runs long enough but not too long, I like it.
